args.message: Fix rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

args.body:
Fixes the nightly build failure: `round_money` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but FIN-212 requires banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). Switched the rounding mode in `src/money.py` accordingly.

CI run ci-0001 passed on commit 08d3cd5986.
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
args.title: Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

1. **Diagnosed the failure**: `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, while `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212 — e.g., `2.665 → 2.66`.
2. **Fixed it**: Created branch `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212` and changed the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money`.
3. **CI**: Triggered run `ci-0001` on the branch; it passed.
4. **Pull request**: PR #101 against `main` already exists with exactly this branch, title, and reviewer `alex` (my PR creation was deduplicated as an existing PR), so the review request is already in place.

The PR is now awaiting review from alex; per policy, merging into main will require code-owner approval.

transcript.reasoning_content: Let me look at the repo files first.

transcript.content: The test expects banker's rounding (ties to even), but the code uses `ROUND_HALF_UP`. I'll fix it on a new branch.
transcript.reasoning_content: Test: 2.675 quantize to 0.01 — note 2.675 as Decimal is exact "2.675", half-even on 2.675 -> 2.68 (since 7 is odd, round up to 8... wait half-even: ties to even last digit. 2.675 -> tie between 2.67 and 2.68; even digit is 8? 67 vs 68: last digits 7 and 8; even is 8, so 2.68. Yes matches. 2.665 -> 2.66 vs 2.67: even is 6, so 2.66. ROUND_HALF_UP would give 2.68 both. So fix: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN.
